At `b919f35bc280f0ef29fce05b1b4a865887f29244`, the [scheduled Node 26/Bun job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/actions/runs/45012114155/job/137176480632) waited unassigned for 9h 29m 41s. Once assigned, checkout, install and strict health passed, but the full release gate reported `the c8 coverage run exceeded its 3600000 ms deadline`. The interrupted test receipt showed 825 passed, 39 cancelled and zero assertion failures; partial coverage is not a pass. The [previous push at the same commit](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/actions/runs/44927333228) had three deadline failures and one successful Node 26/Bun leg on a different runner. This evidence does not establish OOM or any particular host or resource bottleneck. The [quick/deep design](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/pull/79) retains comprehensive tests and full four-dimension coverage in each deep leg. The [job](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/b919f35bc280f0ef29fce05b1b4a865887f29244/.github/workflows/ci-deep.yml#L15-L29) has 120 minutes, but [c8](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/b919f35bc280f0ef29fce05b1b4a865887f29244/scripts/coverage-gate.ts#L250-L280) separately has 60 minutes and two test workers. Reuse [the native CI coverage item](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/b919f35bc280f0ef29fce05b1b4a865887f29244/.agents/pm/issues/pm-swarm-9bks.toon), whose older reporter heap incident is distinct from the evidence here. Acceptance: measure queue wait separately from execution, and use stage timings, peak memory and actual termination reasons from comparable runs before adding more CI load. Demonstrate complete deep gate receipts with time headroom for eligible runners, or document routing the heavy gate to a runner class that can finish it. Preserve existing required checks, coverage scope and thresholds, install acceptance and strict health. An incomplete run must not become a success. --- ### GitHub comments (3) > **@coderabbitai[bot]** (2026-11-22T21:35:22Z) > > > > >

The Node 22/npm leg also reported the c8 deadline. > > The most useful first profile is [the close-crash matrix](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/b919f35bc280f0ef29fce05b1b4a865887f29244/test/close-crash-matrix.test.ts#L6): the 1-, 2- and 3-dependent cases passed in about 8, 12 and 16 minutes in each Node 26 leg.
